verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated Third-Party Risk Management product that automatically discovers vendors, pulls findings from SOC2 reports/DPAs/questionnaires, and monitors ongoing vendor risk — directly replacing spreadsheet-based vendor inventories with continuous, automated review. This covers posture, data access context, and review cadence via its TPRM Agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on customer validation of TPRM workflows and more detail on data-access-specific risk scoring beyond vendor doc marketing pages.
